scripts.dev: bun run --parallel dev:api dev:mcp dev:app dev:landing
scripts.build: bun --cwd apps/app build && bun --cwd apps/landing build
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd apps/app typecheck && bun --cwd apps/landing typecheck
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.check: bun run test:deploy && bun run test:web && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run check:rust
